modalLead: A round of fixes across the dashboard, Bookmarks, Inbox and Health, and the public demo gets statistics of its own.

items.text: Shift + Alt + ←/→ moves a bookmark into the category beside it again.
A page you just clicked stays open when the dashboard reloads in the background.
Keyboard moves skip rows and tabs you cannot see, such as rows behind show more or hidden by a filter.
A failed category rename or icon change is put back instead of showing a change that was never saved.
Changing a URL and moving the bookmark to another page no longer leaves a copy behind on the old page.
Bulk delete and move act on the right bookmarks when the list refreshes while the dialog is open.
A page can no longer end up empty after a moment where its file could not be read.
One failed refresh no longer empties the list, and a held or double key press no longer opens a link twice or skips a card.
A keep whose cleanup fails says so, and the card stays in the inbox.
Retest all on large collections checks the least recently checked bookmarks first, so every bookmark gets its turn.
A re-check that could not be saved says so instead of showing Reachable again.
The public demo counts its visits separately from real installs, and says so in the demo bar. Its Privacy & sync tab is locked.
